page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. No margin notes. Catchword "in" at the lower right.

main_text.l: Obsessus ab infortunis, vel ipsorum radiis.
In malo aspectu Lunæ vel aliorum.
Separatus à fortuna, seu recedens ab ea, & infortunæ ap-plicans.
Peregrinus, id est, cùm non existit in aliqua suarum digni-tatum.
Conjunctus Planetæ existenti in casu vel detrimento suo.
main_text.p: Habet autem Saturnus detrimentum suum in cancro & leone: casum in ariete.

Jupiter detrimentum habet in geminis & virgine, cadit autem in capricorno, nam in cancro exaltatur, unde præceden-ti & hoc anno Jupiter fuit in sua exaltatione, videlicet cancro, in quo magnarum est virium.
Mars detrimentum capit in libra & tauro, sed cadit in cancro.
Sol detrimentum patitur in aquario, casum in libra.
Venus detrimentum capessit in scorpione & ariete, cadit in virgine.
Mercurius detrimentum habet in piscibus (in quibus etiam, nisi à Venere juvetur, plane eum reddidisse stupidos, compertum habetur) & sagittario, casum in iisdem piscibus, nam-in

page.notes: No printed notes in the margins. Faint show-through from the reverse side of the leaf (ghosted lines, notably at the right and centre) has been left out. Long s has been written as plain s throughout. The line-end hook after "in" in the Mars paragraph is read as a continuation mark, not a hyphen.
